results.title: Shadows
results.overview: At a crowded airport, Ahlam, a 14-year-old mother, is running away from Baghdad, the only place she’s ever known. As she fights the shadows lurking around her, she reflects on her journey to reclaim her life.

results.title: Sunflower
results.overview: In a war-torn country, young Danuta and her family play a dangerous game of hide-and-seek with soldiers. Amidst the chaos, Danuta finds comfort and hope in a sunflower, that connects her back with her loved ones.

results.title: Wreckless
results.overview: At her first Alcoholics Anonymous meeting, Lucy begins to suspect her reality isn't as it seems. Paranoia sets in, she confronts a mysterious, traumatic past and questions those closest, ultimately challenging her very sense of self.

results.title: Flynn
results.overview: A gripping and revealing true film exploring the life of General Michael Flynn, from his rise in the US Military, to severe political persecution he faced exposing corruption as the National Security Advisor to the POTUS.

results.title: Reel Talk
results.overview: Two friends reconnect and embark on a philosophical conversation.

results.title: Joan
results.overview: A woman looks for her fiance on her wedding day. Based upon folklore and literature surrounding James Harris, the Daemon Lover, including “House Carpenter” broadsides and the work of Shirley Jackson and Elizabeth Bowen.

results.title: A Miracle
results.overview: Amid drought and famine in Cupang, young Elsa claims to have seen the Virgin Mary and subsequently been blessed with the ability to heal the sick. As people flock to witness her powers, the village becomes consumed by faith, prosperity, greed, and deceit. Is Elsa truly a symbol of hope in a world desperate for salvation?

results.title: Hotz
results.overview: A man and a pregnant woman are crossing a snowy forest, trying to escape a dark past linked to a traumatic crime, but she is waiting for them, hidden among the trees, determined to stop them.

results.title: Ngesot
results.overview: When his car plunged into a deep ravine surrounded by thick jungle, the man, with broken arms and legs, painstakingly crawled for days to find a way out.

results.title: Winner
results.overview: Winner is a brilliant young misfit from Texas who finds her morals challenged while serving in the U.S. Air Force and working as an NSA contractor. A fresh take on the traditional whistleblower thriller, the coming-of-age story follows an idealistic young woman persecuted for standing by her principles.

results.title: Honeywell
results.overview: When Sophia Honeywell dies and appears in a desert-like afterlife, she must compete with a selfish loner for her spot back on Earth and a second chance at her life.

results.title: Road Diary: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band
results.original_title: Road Diary: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band
results.overview: This documentary opens a new door to Springsteen's creative process for fans around the world, sharing fly-on-the-wall footage of band rehearsals and special moments backstage — as well as hearing from Springsteen himself.

results.title: Citizen of a Kind
results.overview: After a fire destroys her laundromat, a single mother is tricked by a phishing scheme. Consequently, she decides to investigate the criminals behind it.

results.title: Vellichor
results.overview: Charo, a curious girl, arrives home and discovers her sister's absence. Exploring the room, you stumble upon a vast library. Unable to read, Charo scatters books throughout the room, creating a world of imagination. This short film, inspired by a memory of the director, celebrates childhood creativity and the transformative power of books in children's lives.

results.title: Valo Manush | ভালো মানুষ
results.overview: A kind-hearted man’s simple honesty and goodness begin to change the lives of those around him in Valo Manush.

results.title: 10 Days of a Curious Man
results.overview: When a young woman goes missing in Istanbul, a jaded writer gets tangled up in a deadly chain of events as he sets out to find her—and a good story.

results.title: The Flood
results.overview: 1792. Louis XVI, his wife Marie Antoinette, and their children have been arrested and imprisoned in the Tour du Temple, a sinister chateau in Paris, awaiting their trial. Far from the splendour of Versailles, they are isolated and vulnerable for the first time in their lives.

results.title: Párvulos: Children of the Apocalypse
results.overview: In a dystopian future ravaged by a viral apocalypse, three young brothers—Salvador, Oliver, and Benjamin—find themselves isolated in a remote cabin deep within the woods. As they navigate this desolate world, they harbor a dark and disturbing secret in their basement, a presence they must feed to ensure their own survival.

results.title: Abruptio
results.overview: Les Hackel is a guy down on his luck who wakes to find an explosive device has been implanted in his neck. He must carry out heinous crimes in order to stay alive while trying to identify the mastermind manipulating the now twisted and strange world around him.
